summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with video/catalog types plus subscription/likes/comments storage, and a React frontend with themed app shell, II-based auth hooks/components, video cards/player, subscription gating, comments UI, like button, and share button. Some requirements are not fully evidenced or appear incomplete based on the visible snippets (notably seeded catalog size and per-user like state).

missing_requirements.requirement: Seed the app with a small default catalog where at least 3 sample videos are returned from the list endpoint after deployment.
missing_requirements.reason: The visible seed catalog in backend/main.mo shows only two videos (video1, video2). The diff is truncated, but no third seed video is evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend must display current user like state and remain correct after refresh (requires retrieving per-user like state from backend).
missing_requirements.reason: LikeButton tracks `isLiked` only in local component state and resets it on videoId change; it does not query backend for the caller’s current like state, so correctness after refresh is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management (get/save caller profile) and a profile setup modal prompting for a name.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requirements do not include user profile/name collection features.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/authorization initialization via secret URL parameter `caffeineAdminToken` and access-control mixin usage.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request an admin token mechanism or access-control initialization flow beyond Internet Identity auth for users.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes a promotional outbound link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested as part of product requirements; could be considered extraneous branding.
